# The gs_ffi_mobile_* C ABI, one symbol per line.
#
# BOTH CHECKS IN android-native.yml READ THIS FILE: the cheap floor before the
# build is verified, and the per-symbol set comparison after. They therefore
# provably describe the same set, and a new symbol cannot be added to one and
# forgotten in the other.
#
# ios-native.yml DOES NOT READ THIS FILE, on purpose. It pins a ten-symbol
# SUBSET -- the non-diffusion surface, listed inline in that workflow. The iOS
# DEVICE slice is not required to carry the sd_* entry points, so pointing its
# check at the full list here would fail it for a reason that has nothing to do
# with iOS. When the iOS slice does gain the SD symbols, move that list here
# too; until then, the subset stays where the rule that explains it lives.
#
# The floor check used to be a literal `-ge 17` in the workflow with a comment
# claiming it "matches the ABI". It did not, and it would have kept passing at 17
# while the ABI was 18 -- a floor cannot notice a set growing. That is why the
# count is now `wc -l` of this file rather than a number anyone has to remember
# to bump.
#
# Names only. The `gs_` prefix is not repeated: these are suffixes, and the
# checker concatenates it, so a line here can never disagree with the pattern it
# is grepped for.
abi_version
backend_available
build_info
chat
create
create_tuned
embed_dim
embed_image
free
ocr
should_use_local
sd_create
sd_set_options
sd_available
sd_backend_name
sd_generate
sd_free
render_svg
